captions.detailed: An aerodynamic road bicycle front fork assembly featuring a matte black finish. It consists of a fork crown with two tapered, aero-profiled fork legs ending in silver dropouts, a central head tube sleeve, a stem riser, and a set of narrow drop handlebars with integrated brake hood mockups. The handlebars are mounted to the stem and support continuous rotational adjustment about the horizontal stem clamp axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an aero road bike fork with an integrated stem and drop handlebars. The handlebars should be mounted to the stem clamp with a continuous revolute joint to allow angle adjustments, and the entire assembly should have a sleek, matte black finish with silver accents on the dropouts.
captions.factory: Construct the model using three main parts: a fixed frame/headtube segment, a fork with a steerer tube, and the handlebars. Model the fork using tapered extrusions for the aero legs, combined with small metallic boxes for the dropouts. Create the handlebars by sweeping circular profiles along a 3D path to form the drops and flats, adding rectangular blocks for the brake hoods. Define a continuous joint between the stem clamp and the handlebar center to allow rotational adjustment.
